Date of Discovery: a few days ago (relative to mid-May 2023)
Method of Attack: Inject arbitrary JavaScript code into any website visited via serasearchtop[.]com domain
Hijacking search results to display sponsored links and paid results
Adware behavior pushing spam or unwanted ads
Code activation 24 hours after installation to evade detection

Indicators of Compromise: User reports of redirections and search result hijacking
Extensions with obfuscated code masquerading as legitimate APIs (Mozilla’s WebExtension Polyfill, Day.js library)
